summary: A 1929 pole platform and tent cabin on Richmond Peak in the Lolo National Forest; the 20-foot L-4 tower of 1935 was destroyed in 1965.

facts.design: 20-foot pole L-4 tower; site first established in 1929 with a pole platform and tent cabin
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1965; no source describes the site today.

events.note: Established with a 20-foot pole platform and tent cabin

notes_for_editor: The 1965 destruction date and the 1929 and 1935 dates rest on firelookout.com alone. The Montana History Portal photo (about 1959) fits the 20-foot height but does not say who staffed the lookout, so no staffing fact is recorded. A Facebook post by FFLA and a Montana Standard article on Lolo fire towers were not readable (rate-limited or empty), and the article may cover 1965 demolition policy. Record kind tower and coordinates match both sources.
